newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE BAT FIRST IN DAY/NIGHT MATCH AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE BAT FIRST IN DAY/NIGHT MATCH AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: India won the toss and put Zimbabwe in to bat in their day/night triangular series match on Sunday.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia, Javagal Srinath, Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad.
Zimbabwe - Grant Flower, Stuart Carlisle, Andy Flower, Alistair Campbell (captain), Dave Houghton, Craig Evans, Guy Whittall, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
